  248   def pbSpeed
  249     return 1 if fainted?
  250     stage = @stages[:SPEED] + STAT_STAGE_MAXIMUM
  251     speed = @speed * STAT_STAGE_MULTIPLIERS[stage] / STAT_STAGE_DIVISORS[stage]
  252     speedMult = 1.0
  253     # Ability effects that alter calculated Speed
  254     if abilityActive?
  255       speedMult = Battle::AbilityEffects.triggerSpeedCalc(self.ability, self, speedMult)
  256     end
  257     # Item effects that alter calculated Speed
  258     if itemActive?
  259       speedMult = Battle::ItemEffects.triggerSpeedCalc(self.item, self, speedMult)
  260     end
  261     # Other effects
  262     speedMult *= 2 if pbOwnSide.effects[PBEffects::Tailwind] > 0
  263     speedMult /= 2 if pbOwnSide.effects[PBEffects::Swamp] > 0
  264     # Paralysis
  265     if status == :PARALYSIS && !hasActiveAbility?(:QUICKFEET)
  266       speedMult /= (Settings::MECHANICS_GENERATION >= 7) ? 2 : 4
  267     end
  268     # Badge multiplier
  269     if @battle.internalBattle && pbOwnedByPlayer? &&
  270        @battle.pbPlayer.badge_count >= Settings::NUM_BADGES_BOOST_SPEED
  271       speedMult *= 1.1
  272     end
  273     # Calculation
  274     return [(speed * speedMult).round, 1].max
  275   end

  277   def pbWeight
  278     ret = (@pokemon) ? @pokemon.weight : 500
  279     ret += @effects[PBEffects::WeightChange]
  280     ret = 1 if ret < 1
  281     if abilityActive? && !@battle.moldBreaker
  282       ret = Battle::AbilityEffects.triggerWeightCalc(self.ability, self, ret)
  283     end
  284     if itemActive?
  285       ret = Battle::ItemEffects.triggerWeightCalc(self.item, self, ret)
  286     end
  287     return [ret, 1].max
  288   end

  307   # Returns the active types of this Pokémon. The array should not include the
  308   # same type more than once, and should not include any invalid types.
  309   def pbTypes(withExtraType = false)
  310     ret = @types.uniq
  311     # Burn Up erases the Fire-type.
  312     ret.delete(:FIRE) if @effects[PBEffects::BurnUp]
  313     # Roost erases the Flying-type. If there are no types left, adds the Normal-
  314     # type.
  315     if @effects[PBEffects::Roost]
  316       ret.delete(:FLYING)
  317       ret.push(:NORMAL) if ret.length == 0
  318     end
  319     # Add the third type specially.
  320     if withExtraType && @effects[PBEffects::ExtraType] && !ret.include?(@effects[PBEffects::ExtraType])
  321       ret.push(@effects[PBEffects::ExtraType])
  322     end
  323     return ret
  324   end

  326   def pbHasType?(type)

  339   # NOTE: Do not create any held item which affects whether a Pokémon's ability
  340   #       is active. The ability Klutz affects whether a Pokémon's item is
  341   #       active, and the code for the two combined would cause an infinite loop
  342   #       (regardless of whether any Pokémon actually has either the ability or
  343   #       the item - the code existing is enough to cause the loop).
  344   def abilityActive?(ignore_fainted = false, check_ability = nil)
  345     return false if fainted? && !ignore_fainted
  346     return false if @effects[PBEffects::GastroAcid]
  347     return false if check_ability != :NEUTRALIZINGGAS && self.ability != :NEUTRALIZINGGAS &&
  348                     @battle.pbCheckGlobalAbility(:NEUTRALIZINGGAS)
  349     return true
  350   end

  352   def hasActiveAbility?(check_ability, ignore_fainted = false)
  353     return false if !abilityActive?(ignore_fainted, check_ability)
  354     return check_ability.include?(@ability_id) if check_ability.is_a?(Array)
  355     return self.ability == check_ability
  356   end
